scopes.account_security:read: View sign-in methods, two-factor status, and sessions.
scopes.account_security:write: Change password, sign-in bindings, two-factor settings, sessions, or delete your account after confirmation on this site.
scopes.api_key:read: View your API key settings without exposing complete keys.
scopes.api_key:reveal: Reveal complete API keys after confirmation on this site.
scopes.api_key:write: Create and manage credentials bound to this application authorization.
scopes.app_center:read: View managed applications, releases, announcements, and telemetry.
scopes.app_center:reveal: Reveal or rotate telemetry credentials after confirmation on this site.
scopes.app_center:write: Manage applications, releases, uploaded assets, announcements, and telemetry.
scopes.billing:read: View financial reports, top-up records, subscription plans, and user subscriptions.
scopes.billing:write: Manage financial entries, complete top-up orders, and administer subscriptions.
scopes.channel:operate: Test channels, refresh balances, and enable or disable channels.
scopes.channel:read: View channel lists and details without secrets.
scopes.channel:secret_view: View complete channel keys after confirmation on this site.
scopes.channel:sensitive_write: Create channels or edit upstream keys, base URLs, and overrides with your existing channel permissions.
scopes.channel:write: Edit channel models, groups, and routing rules with your existing channel permissions.
scopes.deployment:read: View deployments, logs, infrastructure, and price estimates.
scopes.deployment:write: Create, modify, extend, or delete deployments and test connections.
scopes.group:read: View groups and prefill group configuration.
scopes.group:write: Create, edit, and delete prefill groups.
scopes.log:read: View account-wide usage logs, statistics, and tasks with administrator permissions.
scopes.model:read: View model and vendor configuration and upstream synchronization previews.
scopes.model:write: Edit models and vendors and synchronize upstream model configuration.
scopes.oauth_clients:write: Create, modify, disable, or delete OAuth clients after confirmation on this site.
scopes.oauth_grants:read: View applications authorized by your account after confirmation on this site.
scopes.oauth_grants:write: Reduce or revoke application authorizations after confirmation on this site.
scopes.offline_access: Renew access until you revoke the application or the authorization expires.
scopes.openid: Identify your account using OpenID Connect.
scopes.ops:read: View service performance, logs, system tasks, and instances.
scopes.ops:write: Run maintenance tasks, clear caches, and manage service operation settings.
scopes.option:read: View system settings, identity providers, and price synchronization sources.
scopes.option:write: Change system settings, identity providers, and price synchronization configuration.
scopes.profile:read: View your account, settings, available models, and group availability.
scopes.profile:write: Change your display name and personal settings.
scopes.redemption:write: Create, edit, and delete redemption codes.
scopes.relay:invoke: Send model requests, create generation tasks, and use streaming or realtime responses with your account balance.
scopes.relay:read: Read available models and the usage of this application's relay credentials.
scopes.relay:tasks: Read and manage generation tasks owned by your account.
scopes.usage:read: View your usage logs, statistics, and task history.
scopes.user:read: View users and their account information with your existing administrator permissions.
scopes.user:write: Create, modify, disable, or delete users and reset their security settings within your existing permissions.
scopes.wallet:read: View balance, top-ups, subscriptions, and referral information.
scopes.wallet:write: Start payments, buy subscriptions, redeem credit, check in, and transfer referral rewards.
